conditions.baseline: VistaSport retrieval and catalog fields only
conditions.enriched: Same retrieval, model, system instruction and temperature, plus matched community aggregates

primary_metric: fully passed case generations / all case generations

beginner_control_budget: all cited products cost at most 6000 RUB
fast_attack_carbon: all cited products have an explicit carbon/composite marker
multiple manufacturer scales get an explicit non-comparability caveat
defense_long_pips: compatibility is either withheld for insufficient data or tied to an exact N-of-M review aggregate
available long-pips evidence must be used
soft_inner_carbon: soft feel is tied to a direct field/exact aggregate or explicitly withheld
underspecified_request: no product is recommended before clarification

attempt2: 12 answers, false positive on negated confirmation; audit exposed missed speed superlative
attempt3: 14 answers, noun compatibility in a negated sentence falsely treated as positive; grader missed noncomparability synonym
attempt4: 13 answers, real unsupported long-pips recommendation rejected repeatedly; safe catalog fallback added with explicit provenance
